title: Twisted-Convolution Identities in Dimensions Seven and Eight: Shintani Height Rigidity and CM Descent — Reproducibility Archive
description: Submission-specific reproducibility archive for the unconditional formal Twisted Convolution Conjecture in both admissible dimension-seven strata (discriminants 8 and 32) and both admissible dimension-eight strata. It contains the manuscript source and PDF, exact conductor-lowering, ray-field, CM-descent, phase, and minor certificates, rigorous Arb enclosures, regression tests, and a deterministic self-checksumming archive.
